product.body_html:
Biodance Caviar PDRN Dual Gel Toner Pads

Description

These dual-sided gel toner pads are soaked in a cooling, soothing essence infused with caviar water and PDRN to deliver deep hydration and a visibly brighter complexion. The embossed side gently exfoliates dead skin cells and smooths texture, while the soft reverse side wraps skin in a calming, moisture-locking finish. Ideal for sensitive, irritated skin, the formula helps strengthen the moisture barrier and even out skin tone without any sticky residue.

Each pad is generously saturated so you can swipe it across your face as a daily toner or leave it on targeted areas as a quick five-minute treatment pack. The lightweight, refreshing essence absorbs fast, leaving skin plump, dewy, and prepped for the rest of your routine.

How to Use

1. After cleansing, in the first step of your skincare routine, gently wipe the entire face, excluding the eye area, following the skin texture.
[TIP] Place the pad on areas that need intensive hydration and use it as a toner pack.

Ingredients

Water, Caviar Water (100,867ppm), Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, Methylpropanediol, Niacinamide, Hydroxyacetophenone, Diethoxyethyl Succinate, Squalane, 1,2-Hexanediol, Vinyl Dimethicone, Sodium DNA (1,000ppm), Allantoin, Xanthan Gum, Panthenol, Polyglyceryl-10 Laurate, Polyglyceryl-10 Stearate, Adenosine, Polyglyceryl-10 Oleate, Glyceryl Acrylate/Acrylic Acid Copolymer, Sodium Phytate, PVM/MA Copolymer, Lactic Acid, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Gluconolactone, Salicylic Acid, Ethylhexylglycerin, Sodium Hyaluronate, Salmon Egg Extract, Caviar Extract (10.3ppm), Capryloyl Salicylic Acid

Specs

  • Brand: Biodance
  • Capacity: 60 pads / 2.99 oz. (85 g)
  • Target Area: Face
  • Skin Type: All Skin Types
  • Country of Origin: South Korea
